provenance: Project-authored overlay for the supplied office pack. Personas are archetypes, not named people. Synergy factors and signal readings are synthetic and unvalidated.

personas.title: Group Finance Director
personas.archetype: Owns occupancy cost and capital approval
personas.quote: Show me which lease decision this changes, and how we will know it worked.

personas.title: Head of Portfolio Strategy
personas.archetype: Shapes the estate plan across buildings
personas.quote: I need demand by floor and hour, not badge counts by month.
pains: No link between space and energy plans
decisions: Where to invest in collaboration space

personas.title: Workplace Experience Lead
personas.quote: Consolidation only works if people can still find a room that works.
pains: Ticket data is siloed from room data
Complaints arrive after people stop coming in

personas.title: Hybrid Team Lead
personas.archetype: Voice of the people who use the space
personas.quote: Tuesdays are packed and Fridays are empty. The building does not seem to know.
pains: Too hot or too cold on quiet days

personas.title: Energy & Sustainability Manager
personas.archetype: Reports energy intensity and net-zero progress
personas.quote: I can report total kWh. I cannot yet report kWh per occupied hour.

personas.title: Facilities Operations Manager
personas.archetype: Approves simulated work orders in the runtime demo
personas.quote: Give me a proposed change I can review. Never change the BMS for me.
decisions: Approve or reject a work-order draft

personas.title: CISO / Data Protection Officer
personas.archetype: Governs data use, privacy and segmentation
personas.quote: Aggregate occupancy is fine. Individual tracking is not.

synergies.title: Consolidate and de-energise
synergies.mechanism: Consolidating a floor only saves energy if that floor's HVAC zone moves to setback. The occupancy signal that justifies the space decision also justifies the schedule change.
synergies.extendedOutcome: One decision that lowers portfolio cost and gives a defensible energy-intensity figure for net-zero reporting.
evidenceNeeded: Factorial test: consolidated floor with and without schedule change
Comfort and ventilation limits signed off

synergies.title: Self-tuning workplace operations
synergies.mechanism: Comfort complaints and room tickets show where HVAC schedules hurt experience. Feeding them into schedule reviews avoids saving energy at the cost of people.
synergies.extendedOutcome: Energy reduction that is bounded by experience, run as one managed service instead of two.
evidenceNeeded: Service ownership between SI and FM partner

synergies.title: Adaptive workplace operating model
synergies.mechanism: Space, energy and service decisions share the same occupancy, BMS and ticket signals. Run together, each decision informs the next review cycle.
synergies.extendedOutcome: A portfolio that adjusts space, energy and service to demand every quarter, with one evidence ledger for all three board objectives.

scenarios.label: Steady week
scenarios.description: All synthetic readings inside their thresholds.

scenarios.label: Underused wing, HVAC running
scenarios.description: Low occupancy and high energy per occupied hour in the same wing.

scenarios.label: Meeting-room friction spike
scenarios.description: Ticket volume rises; occupancy and energy look normal. Ticket counts are estimated.

scenarios.label: Stale BMS feed
scenarios.description: Occupancy is low but the energy feed is stale and one ticket reading is malformed.
